push.title: L 1-4 vs Burger Chute | You: 7.8
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.8 against Burger Chute. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

THE GOOD
+ 36 passes, your busiest match yet. You made yourself big and available, and it paid off.
+ 2 key passes. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ Every time you found PhogsToffees, something good happened.
+ Shot accuracy 67%, from 0% in your previous match. Bottle that and bring it next match.

THE BAD
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 24%). Think about this: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you. Brick by brick.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Little homework: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
- 4 goals conceded shaved 0.1 off. Clean that up and you're flying.
- Pass accuracy: 81%. Top midfielders reach 87%+. You've got the legs for it.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. We dug that hole together; we'll climb out together.

Session plan: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Better days are booked. - Coach Lasso
